description: This file defines a template class 'MessageDataBufferType' within the 'WPEFramework::Messaging' namespace. It manages inter-process communication buffers, including a nested 'DataBuffer' class that handles cyclic buffers with doorbell signaling for synchronization. The class provides methods for pushing and popping data, waiting for signals, and managing buffer files, with support for shared memory and file-based communication. It appears to be part of a messaging or IPC system in a larger software project.

classes.name: MessageDataBufferType
classes.description: A template class managing message buffers with synchronization via doorbells, supporting file-based cyclic buffers for IPC.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: A nested class within 'MessageDataBufferType' that extends 'Core::CyclicBuffer' to add signaling and synchronization features for data availability.

methods.name: PushData
methods.description: Writes data into the cyclic buffer, reserving space and notifying the other side via ring.

methods.name: PopData
methods.description: Reads data from the cyclic buffer after a doorbell ring, handling partial reads if necessary.

methods.name: Ring
methods.description: Signals that data is available by ringing the doorbell.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell signal within a specified timeout.

methods.name: FlushDataBuffer
methods.description: Flushes the cyclic buffer, clearing its contents.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the cyclic buffer is valid.

methods.name: MetadataName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with metadata.
